page.title: 節をひとまとまりの主語にする

analysis.summaryJa: that節・whether節・wh節は、内部に主語と動詞を保ったまま全体で一つの名詞相当の主語になれる。that節は事実・平叙内容、whether節は二者択一、wh節は不足情報のまとまりを表す。画像の三つのカプセルと主語の椅子を根拠に、節の境界標識と主節述語との接続を扱う。
grammarPoints: That＋主語＋動詞の節全体が事実・内容を表す主語になる
文頭の主語that節では境界を示すthatを通常省略しない
Whether節は〜かどうか・AかBかを一まとまりの主語にする
wh節は欠けた情報を含む名詞相当の主語になる
主語節全体は通常単数扱いで主節の述語につながる
visualEvidence: THAT・WHETHER・WHの三つのカプセルが一つずつ主語の席に運ばれる
各カプセルにThat＋S＋V、Whether＋S＋V、WH＋S＋Vの式がある
thatを外すと二つの節がつながって曖昧になる警告がある
主語パッケージ全体からpredicateへ進む矢印が描かれる
commonTraps: 文頭のthat主語節からthatを省き節境界を不明確にする
whetherの代わりに文頭主語として口語的なifを使う
wh節内部を直接疑問の倒置語順にする
主語節の直後に不要なitを重ねる

questions.prompt: ------- the shipment arrived early surprised the receiving team.

choices.C: That

questions.translationJa: 荷物が早く届いたという事実が受入チームを驚かせました。
questions.explanationJa: 平叙内容全体を主語にするため文頭にThatを置きます。

questions.prompt: ------- the candidate accepts the offer remains uncertain.

choices.C: That question

questions.translationJa: 候補者が採用条件を受け入れるかどうかは不確かです。
questions.explanationJa: 二択の不確実性を文頭主語にする正式形はWhetherです。

questions.prompt: ------- caused the billing error is still under investigation.

choices.C: Whether did

questions.translationJa: 何が請求エラーを引き起こしたかはまだ調査中です。
questions.explanationJa: whatが節内の主語を兼ね、wh節全体が主文の主語になります。

questions.prompt: ------- the new branch will open depends on the permit approval.

choices.C: That when

questions.translationJa: 新支店がいつ開店するかは許可の承認次第です。
questions.explanationJa: wh節内はwhen＋主語the branch＋動詞will openの通常語順です。

questions.prompt: That the figures were revised ------- clear from the audit notes.

choices.C: be

questions.translationJa: 数値が修正されたことは監査メモから明らかです。
questions.explanationJa: That節全体を一つの主語として単数扱いし、isを使います。

questions.prompt: Whether we renew or cancel the service ------- on next quarter’s budget.

choices.C: depends

questions.translationJa: サービスを更新するか解約するかは来四半期の予算次第です。
questions.explanationJa: Whether節全体が単数主語なのでdependsを続け、余分なitは置きません。

questions.prompt: What the survey revealed ------- our marketing strategy.

choices.C: was change

questions.translationJa: 調査で明らかになったことが当社の販売戦略を変えました。
questions.explanationJa: What the survey revealed全体が主語で、その直後に述語changedを置きます。

questions.prompt: ------- every employee completed the training was encouraging.

choices.C: Whether completed did

questions.translationJa: 全従業員が研修を修了したことは心強いことでした。
questions.explanationJa: 事実内容を主語パッケージにするthatを文頭で明示します。

questions.prompt: Where the missing parcel was delivered ------- a mystery.

choices.C: it remains

questions.translationJa: 紛失した荷物がどこに配達されたかは謎のままです。
questions.explanationJa: Where節全体が単数主語なのでremainsを直接続けます。

questions.prompt: ------- the two proposals differ is explained in Appendix B.

choices.C: That how

questions.translationJa: 2つの提案がどのように異なるかは付録Bで説明されています。
questions.explanationJa: How＋主語＋動詞の通常語順でwh節を作り、全体を主語にします。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a that-clause subject.

choices.A: The office moved surprised several clients.
choices.B: That did the office move surprised several clients.
choices.C: That the office moved it surprised several clients.
choices.D: That the office moved surprised several clients.

questions.translationJa: オフィスが移転したという事実が何人かの顧客を驚かせました。
questions.explanationJa: 文頭のThatが内容節の始まりを示し、節全体がsurprisedの主語です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a whether-clause subject.

choices.A: If the supplier can meet the deadline is unclear.
choices.B: Whether the supplier can meet the deadline is unclear.
choices.C: Whether can the supplier meet the deadline is unclear.
choices.D: Whether the supplier can meet the deadline it is unclear.

questions.translationJa: 仕入先が期限に間に合うかどうかは不明です。
questions.explanationJa: 文頭の正式な二択主語節にはWhetherを使い、内部は平叙語順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a wh-clause subject.

choices.A: Why did the system fail has not been determined.
choices.B: Why the system failed it has not been determined.
choices.C: Why the system failed has not been determined.
choices.D: That why the system failed has not been determined.

questions.translationJa: なぜシステムが停止したのかは特定されていません。
questions.explanationJa: wh節内はwhy＋主語＋動詞の通常語順で、全体が主語になります。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about an unknown recipient.

choices.A: Who received the package remains unknown.
choices.B: Who did receive the package it remains unknown.
choices.C: Who the package received remains unknown.
choices.D: Did who receive the package remains unknown.

questions.translationJa: 誰が荷物を受け取ったかは不明のままです。
questions.explanationJa: whoが節内の主語を兼ね、Who received the package全体が主文主語です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with singular agreement.

choices.A: That both rooms are available are good news.
choices.B: That both rooms are available it is good news.
choices.C: Both rooms are available is good news.
choices.D: That both rooms are available is good news.

questions.translationJa: 2室とも利用可能だということは朗報です。
questions.explanationJa: 内部に複数名詞roomsがあってもthat節全体は一つの主語なのでisです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about two alternatives.

choices.A: If we ship today or tomorrow depends on the carrier.
choices.B: Whether do we ship today or tomorrow depends on the carrier.
choices.C: Whether we ship today or tomorrow depends on the carrier.
choices.D: Whether we ship today or tomorrow it depends on the carrier.

questions.translationJa: 今日発送するか明日発送するかは運送業者次第です。
questions.explanationJa: Whether A or Bを一まとまりの主語にし、dependsを直接続けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using a what-clause as subject.

choices.A: What did the client request requires special packaging.
choices.B: What the client requested requires special packaging.
choices.C: What the client requested it requires special packaging.
choices.D: The client requested what requires special packaging.

questions.translationJa: 顧客が依頼したものには特別な梱包が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: whatがrequestedの目的語を兼ね、節全体がrequiresの主語です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about location information.

choices.A: Where will the meeting take place is printed on the invitation.
choices.B: Where the meeting will take place it is printed on the invitation.
choices.C: That where the meeting will take place is printed on the invitation.
choices.D: Where the meeting will take place is printed on the invitation.

questions.translationJa: 会議がどこで開かれるかは招待状に印刷されています。
questions.explanationJa: 埋込みwh節はwhere＋主語＋will＋動詞の通常語順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence marking a stated fact.

choices.A: The payment was duplicated is evident from the receipt.
choices.B: That was the payment duplicated is evident from the receipt.
choices.C: That the payment was duplicated is evident from the receipt.
choices.D: That the payment was duplicated it is evident from the receipt.

questions.translationJa: 支払いが重複したことはレシートから明らかです。
questions.explanationJa: thatが平叙内容を主語パッケージとして明確に区切ります。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a how-clause subject.

choices.A: How the device stores data is explained in the manual.
choices.B: How does the device store data is explained in the manual.
choices.C: How the device stores data it is explained in the manual.
choices.D: That how the device stores data is explained in the manual.

questions.translationJa: 装置がデータをどのように保存するかは説明書に記載されています。
questions.explanationJa: how節内部はthe device storesの通常語順で、全体を主語にします。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “That the venue changed surprised us.”

choices.A: We were surprised by the fact that the venue changed.
choices.B: We changed the venue to surprise everyone.
choices.C: The venue was surprised by us.
choices.D: No change was made to the venue.

questions.translationJa: 会場が変わったという事実に私たちは驚きました。
questions.explanationJa: that節主語の事実内容をthe fact that節で言い換えています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Whether the plan is affordable is uncertain.”

choices.A: No one has prepared a plan.
choices.B: The plan’s price has already been approved.
choices.C: It is uncertain whether the plan is affordable.

questions.translationJa: その計画が手頃かどうかは不確かです。
questions.explanationJa: whether節を形式主語itの後ろへ移しても同じ二択の不確実性を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “What happened next remains unclear.”

choices.B: It remains unclear what happened next.
choices.C: The next event was clearly announced.

questions.translationJa: 次に何が起きたのかは不明のままです。
questions.explanationJa: what節主語をIt remains unclearの後ろへ置いて同じ意味にしています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “When the store will reopen depends on the repairs.”

choices.A: The store has reopened despite unfinished repairs.
choices.B: The reopening date is determined by the progress of the repairs.
choices.C: The repairs depend on the store’s customers.

questions.translationJa: 店の再開時期は修理の進み具合で決まります。
questions.explanationJa: when節が再開時期という情報を一まとまりの主語として表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “That Ms. Lin remembered the code was fortunate.”

choices.A: It was fortunate that Ms. Lin remembered the code.
choices.B: Ms. Lin forgot the code unfortunately.
choices.C: The code created Ms. Lin’s fortune.

questions.translationJa: リンさんがコードを覚えていたことは幸運でした。
questions.explanationJa: that節主語を形式主語Itの後ろへ移した同義文です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Whether we expand depends on demand.”

choices.B: Our decision to expand or not is determined by demand.
choices.C: Demand will disappear if we expand.
choices.D: Demand depends only on office size.

questions.translationJa: 事業を拡大するかどうかは需要次第です。
questions.explanationJa: whether節が拡大する・しないの二択全体を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Who approved the expense is recorded in the system.”

choices.A: The system approves every expense automatically.
choices.C: The speaker asks the system to approve an expense.
choices.D: The system records the identity of the person who approved the expense.

questions.translationJa: 経費を承認した人物はシステムに記録されています。
questions.explanationJa: who節が承認者の身元情報を一まとまりの主語として表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “How the error occurred is still a mystery.”

choices.A: The error has been completely explained.
choices.B: The mystery caused a different error.
choices.C: Everyone knows when the error occurred.
choices.D: The way the error occurred is still unknown.

questions.translationJa: その誤りがどう発生したかはまだ謎です。
questions.explanationJa: how節が発生の仕方を表し、the way ... is unknownと対応します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “That all seats were reserved caused concern.”

choices.A: The reservation caused more seats to appear.
choices.B: People became concerned because all the seats had been reserved.
choices.C: No one was concerned about seating.

questions.translationJa: 全席が予約済みだったため懸念が生じました。
questions.explanationJa: that節が懸念の原因となった事実全体を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Where the files are stored matters for security.”

choices.A: The storage location of the files is important for security.
choices.B: The files contain no security information.
choices.C: Security determines who wrote the files.
choices.D: Every storage location is equally safe.

questions.translationJa: ファイルの保管場所はセキュリティ上重要です。
questions.explanationJa: where節が保管場所という名詞的情報を主語として表します。

questions.prompt: The shipment reached us two days ahead of schedule. ------- it arrived so early surprised the warehouse manager.

choices.C: If

questions.translationJa: 荷物は予定より2日早く届きました。それほど早く届いたことが倉庫長を驚かせました。
questions.explanationJa: 前文の事実内容をThat＋主語＋動詞で主語パッケージにします。

questions.prompt: The candidate has not responded to the offer. ------- she will accept remains uncertain.

choices.C: That question

questions.translationJa: 候補者は採用条件に返答していません。受け入れるかどうかは不確かです。
questions.explanationJa: yes/noの二択を文頭主語にするのでWhetherを使います。

questions.prompt: The audit identified a large difference in totals. ------- caused it has not yet been determined.

choices.C: That what

questions.translationJa: 監査で合計額に大きな差が見つかりました。何が原因かはまだ特定されていません。
questions.explanationJa: whatがcausedの主語となる節全体を主文主語にします。

questions.prompt: The permit is still under review. When the new office can open ------- on the city’s decision.

choices.C: depends

questions.translationJa: 許可はまだ審査中です。新オフィスの開設時期は市の判断次第です。
questions.explanationJa: When節全体が単数主語なのでdependsを直接続けます。

questions.prompt: All participants completed the safety module. ------- they finished before the deadline is encouraging.

choices.C: If question

questions.translationJa: 参加者全員が安全講習を終えました。期限前に修了したことは心強いです。
questions.explanationJa: 確定した平叙内容を主語にするためThatを明示します。

questions.prompt: We have not decided between air and sea freight. Whether we use one or the other ------- on the customer’s deadline.

choices.C: it depends

questions.translationJa: 航空便か船便かは未決定です。どちらを使うかは顧客の期限次第です。
questions.explanationJa: Whether節全体を単数扱いし、dependsを続けます。

questions.prompt: The customer described several defects. What she reported ------- a full product recall.

choices.C: was prompt

questions.translationJa: 顧客はいくつかの欠陥を説明しました。報告内容が製品の全面回収につながりました。
questions.explanationJa: What she reported全体が主語となり、述語promptedを直接取ります。

questions.prompt: The invitation gives a date but no room number. Where the seminar will be held ------- unclear.

choices.C: remaining

questions.translationJa: 招待状には日付はありますが部屋番号がありません。セミナー会場は不明のままです。
questions.explanationJa: Where節全体が単数主語なのでremainsを使います。

questions.prompt: The two prototypes use different batteries. How they differ ------- explained in the technical note.

choices.C: is

questions.translationJa: 2つの試作品は異なる電池を使います。その違いは技術メモで説明されています。
questions.explanationJa: How they differという節全体を単数主語としてisを使います。

questions.prompt: Management confirmed the relocation this morning. ------- the branch will move in October is now official.

choices.C: Whether question

questions.translationJa: 経営陣は今朝移転を確認しました。支店が10月に移ることは今や正式決定です。
questions.explanationJa: 確定した事実を主語にするthat節を文頭で明示します。
